scientific_integrity: Exact Steiner parallel-body formulas and a monotone isoperimetric ratio establish the unique defeating rounded-triangle comparator on the stated sector-angle interval. Bounded numerical checks only corroborate the continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The result gives strict counterexamples only for 1<=theta<theta_star. Its endpoint is specific to the displayed rounded-equilateral family, not a proven global cutoff; it does not determine any global diameter minimizer. Full primary access to the original Nandakumar text was unavailable in the latest comparison.
title: An exact rounded-triangle counterinterval to the low-area sector conjecture
